conditions.label: Wetness
conditions.description: Triggers while the actor's wetness is at least {param1}% of the maximum.

conditions.label: Wetness stage
conditions.description: Triggers while the actor's skin is {param1} ({param2}).

conditions.label: Wet Function running
conditions.description: Triggers while Wet Function Redux's effect is running on the actor.

effects.label: Wet the skin
effects.description: When shown, the actor's wetness rises by {param1}% of the maximum.

effects.label: Dry the skin
effects.description: When shown, the actor's wetness falls by {param1}% of the maximum.

effects.label: Wetness rate
effects.description: While shown on the player, everyone's skin gets wet and dries at {param1}% of the usual rate.
